fields.description: Issue includes commentary on Dade County grand jury investigations and alleged political manipulation affecting Miami and Miami Beach, with attention to gambling operations and enforcement. Reports and opinion pieces discuss a purported Hialeah Park third-race scandal and track-related allegations, plus sports coverage including boxing items involving Joe Lipps and related disputes. Contains social/entertainment columns and extensive advertising, including promotions tied to President Franklin D. Roosevelt's birthday celebrations and local nightlife and businesses.
